steps.title: Principal orchestrator
steps.summary: Classifies every request, plans, delegates bounded work, inspects each diff itself, runs verification, and owns the outcome.
steps.selects: The default Claude Code model for new sessions. Repositories can override it with claude-codex-init <alias>, and a running session with /model.

steps.title: Luna
steps.summary: The mechanical worker: narrow, repetitive, well-specified edits and boilerplate.
steps.selects: The Codex model behind the luna profile. Its low reasoning effort defines the role and is not configurable.

steps.title: Terra
steps.summary: The implementation worker: contained features, real bug fixes, multi-file changes, one bounded task per run.
steps.selects: The Codex model behind the terra profile. Its medium reasoning effort defines the role and is not configurable.

steps.title: Sol
steps.summary: The independent reviewer: fresh read-only sessions that challenge plans and completed work, and difficult diagnosis.
steps.selects: The Codex model behind the sol profile. Its high reasoning effort defines the role and is not configurable.
